actions.action: Early pay up to 2 days early, permanently
Free replacement card on request and payment alerts

decisions.message: About the small card charges since Monday: they are real. We are investigating with our card processor; we do not yet know the cause or how many customers are affected. Check your card activity in the app and dispute any charge you do not recognize. Ask for a free new card and an alert for every card payment. We never text links or ask for codes. Separately, Dec 12-13 our system upgrade pauses transfers for about 36 hours, cards work offline up to $250; eligible paychecks can now arrive up to 2 days early.
decisions.why:
Real unexplained charges plus a viral 'hacked' post hit trust right before our upgrade; we state what we know and do not know, first.
Free new cards and payment alerts let worried customers act now; early pay and a $250 offline limit still cover the Dec 12-13 weekend.
One decision covers both problems and keeps the second for the deposit risk after the upgrade; every statement is checkable.

actions.action: Savings rate boost for 4 weeks, balances up to $50,000

decisions.message: Thank you for banking with us through our system upgrade. For the next 4 weeks, through January 10, we are adding 0.50 percentage points to your savings rate on balances up to $50,000. Nothing to sign up for. After January 10 your rate returns to our standard rate. Your deposits stay FDIC-insured up to the standard limit.
decisions.why:
Half of deposits sit with 5% of customers who compare rates weekly; this closes the 0.5-point gap right after the upgrade, when they decide.
Starting in week 7, the 4 weeks end on January 10, the day the board measures deposits.
Costs $1.6M, inside the menu and budget; the end date is stated, so nothing is misleading.
